title: Automation switches: a master switch, each workflow, task and service, shipped paused
why: Jason, 2026-11-14 (through the session manager): "Please update the site settings to be off until switched back on, also give me a master switch to turn on and off. Also I see the services as routed services connected to a task so we should be able to turn those on and off as well." New section System Configuration → Automation (Owners and Executives switch; ⓘ explains workflow → task → route → service). (1) The master switch (automation_switches), shipped OFF by its migration: "Paused by Jason, 2026-11-14, until the crawler review". Off stops everything that gathers or creates content: CrawlQueue::paused() says why, so every crawler endpoint and CrawlService::plan answer paused and a Railway run ends at once even if its cron returns; the site's workflow jobs skip in Scheduler::run (guide_finds_tick, guide_ondemand_tick, journeys_tick, heritage_tick, listings_tick, landmark_photos_tick), recorded as a run that worked with "Paused: …"; the AI features that serve workflows (CrawlService::FEATURE_WF) wait in AiClient::allow; the site's gathering calls (OpenPlaces' Overpass, Dossier, PlaceFinder, TravelLegs, the second tier's page reads, landmark photos) aren't made. It never stops business operations: orders, billing, payments, email, releases, staging, Moments, members' and businesses' own actions (card scans, Write it for me), staff presses (Write a draft, Check my facts), guides' weather and roads, the admin. (2) Workflows W1–W13: every one a row of crawl_workflows (the website's own seeded), paused with why and who; site jobs, AI features and on-demand paths honour it (W5: a visitor's ask is kept, queued, with a note and Notify me, and a link to what we list near the place: no dead end; search's offer says guides are paused). (3) Tasks: crawl_capture_tasks.enabled, now with who and why (off_why, off_by, off_at). (4) Services: each outside service can be paused by a person, a status in ServiceHealth (allowed() says "… is paused: why (set by …)"), its hosts sent to the crawler as holds (the task reports held), AI routes to a paused provider closed (providerFor, and before each Claude request); shown on its Outside services card. Services business operations depend on aren't pausable, greyed with the reason. A paused thing is paused, never a failure, never a Pulse warning (CrawlService::stalled is quiet while paused; AI use shows a paused feature as paused). Every change is logged (automation_log) and listed on the page. FAQ: two staff entries, one visitor entry. decisions/0163 §9 (still proposed).

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
